titleEn: Read and accept platform legal notices / policy updates

ar: جالي اشعار سياسة جديدة اعمل ايه؟
en: I got a policy update notice, what do I do?

edgeCases: Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
